components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; color: var(--red, #890405); padding-bottom: 40px; } .ds-letters { display: flex; gap: 10px; } .ds-glyph { position: relative; font-family: var(--display, 'Zilla Slab', Rockwell, 'Roboto Slab', serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1; width: 52px; height: 52px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding-bottom: 4px; border: 4px solid var(--red, #890405); border-radius: 0; color: var(--red, #890405); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-glyph:hover, .ds-glyph.ds-current { background: var(--red, #890405); color: var(--paper, #f7f5f2); } .ds-glyph:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--red, #890405); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-caption { position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 10px); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 100px; color: var(--red, #890405); font-family: var(--body, 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; visibility: hidden; } .ds-glyph:hover .ds-caption, .ds-glyph:focus-visible .ds-caption, .ds-current .ds-caption { visibility: visible; } .ds-site { font-family: var(--display, 'Zilla Slab', Rockwell, serif); font-weight: 700; } .ds-mobile-page { display: none; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-nav { flex-wrap: wrap; padding-bottom: 0; } .ds-glyph { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-width: 3px; } .ds-caption, .ds-site { display: none; } .ds-mobile-page { display: block; flex-basis: 100%; font-family: var(--display, 'Zilla Slab', Rockwell, serif); font-weight: 700; } }

narrative.overview:
The site is one impression of the ItFtI seal. The seal itself is the only frame: it leads the home page at full size, and nothing else on the page is boxed in red. Its language carries through in thick red rules, framed letter blocks and filled slab buttons.

There is one ink and one paper. Everything is red on near-white. Shape is square. Depth is flat. The real seal logo is the focal image on the home page.

Status is told by line form, not by colour or badges. A solid rule means it is built and usable today. A dashed rule means a draft not yet adopted, or something planned.
keyCharacteristics: One ink, one paper, no second colour.
The seal is the only frame; no border around the viewport.
Slab serif headlines, plain sans body.
Square corners, thick rules, no shadows for depth.
One fixed 12-column grid on every page.
Navigation is the name: I, t, F, t, I.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Seal red on paper is the whole palette. Do not add a second colour, a grey, or a gradient.

rules.name: The No Texture Rule
rules.body: Do not imitate ink bleed, stamp grain or paper texture. The seal is the real asset; the page does not fake its material.

rules.name: The Line Form Rule
rules.body: Status is carried by rule style. Solid 8px rule: built and usable today. Dashed 8px rule: draft not yet adopted, or planned. Never use colour or a badge for status.

rules.name: The Slab Heads Rule
rules.body: Headings are Zilla Slab 700, tight at line-height 1, balanced wrap. Body is never slab.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No small caps label above a heading.

rules.name: The Flat Slab Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. Weight is shown with rule thickness (2px, 4px, 8px).

dos: Do use only #890405 on #f7f5f2, with #5e0203 for hover.
Do mark what is built with a solid 8px rule, and drafts or planned work with a dashed 8px rule.
Do use the real seal logo asset as the focal image.
Do keep every page on the shared 12-column grid.
Do keep corners square and depth flat.
Do let the seal be the only frame on the page.
Do keep copy honest about status: ItF is experimental; FtI is draft 0.1 with no funder adoption yet.
donts: Don't add a second colour, grey ramp, tint or gradient.
Don't imitate ink texture, bleed or paper grain.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't use cards, rounded corners or soft shadows.
Don't use colour or badges to show status.
Don't redraw the seal by hand. Use the traced asset.
